raw_segments.text: A squad of constables deboosh'd from College Street, marching in Indian file.
Foodie-aided faces sweating helmets patting their truncheons.
After their feed with a good load of fat soup under their belts.
Policemen's lot is off to happy one.
They split up in groups and scattered, saluting towards their beats.
Best moment to attack one in pudding time.
A squad of others marching irregularly,
rounded Trinity railings making for the station.
